The HR Executive will be responsible for handling end‑to‑end HR operations, including recruitment, employee management, attendance, payroll coordination, employee engagement, HR documentation, company policies, and general administration. The candidate should be capable of managing multiple HR responsibilities in a growing IT company.

Key Responsibilities

1. Recruitment & Selection - Handle end‑to‑end recruitment for technical and non‑technical positions. - Prepare and publish job postings on relevant platforms. - Screen resumes, shortlist candidates, and coordinate interviews. - Manage interview schedules and candidate follow‑ups. - Coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, and onboarding.

2. Employee Management - Manage employee joining, onboarding, and exit formalities. - Maintain employee records and personal files. - Monitor attendance, leave applications, and employee working hours. - Handle employee queries, grievances, and workplace concerns. - Coordinate employee performance reviews and appraisal processes.

3. Payroll & Attendance Management - Coordinate monthly payroll processing. - Maintain salary records, attendance reports, and leave balances. - Prepare monthly payroll inputs and salary‑related reports. - Coordinate salary revisions, deductions, overtime, and pending payments.

5. Employee Engagement & Development - Organise employee engagement activities, celebrations, and team events. - Coordinate employee training and development activities. - Support employee satisfaction and workplace discipline. - Help maintain a positive and productive work environment.

6. General Administration - Handle day‑to‑day office administration and coordination. - Maintain office assets, employee ID cards, and related records. - Coordinate office requirements and vendor‑related activities. - Support management in general operational and administrative activities.

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in HR or HR & Administration.

  • Familiarity with attendance and payroll management.
  • Good communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.
  • Good organisational and problem‑solving skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and Google Workspace.

About the Role

We are seeking a qualified capital/finance professional to lead the Capital & Control workstream for new regulated insurance entities established by the Group – including DFSA, Cayman and Lloyd’s structures. The primary focus is on new entity establishment: defining the capital structure, building the financial control framework, and establishing the regulatory reporting infrastructure from inception. This is a build‑focused role for someone comfortable standing things up from scratch, not just running steady‑state reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the financial establishment of new regulated entities (DFSA, Cayman, Lloyd’s, etc.) – define opening balance sheet, capital structure, and financial control framework; ensure proper capitalization before business starts.

  • Establish the regulatory reporting framework for each jurisdiction (design reporting pack, set calendar, produce first returns) and hand over to ongoing support.
  • Create three‑statement financial models and entity‑level P&L; set up the management reporting suite for ongoing reporting.
  • Design the reinsurance programme accounting structure (quota share, excess of loss, ceding commission) and ensure correct accounting treatment and controls.
  • Produce the first monthly management accounts and entity‑level reporting pack, defining format, commentary, and distribution; support ongoing production for existing entities.
  • Reconcile intercompany balances and positions across group entities.
